meta.name: frustration-detection
meta.description: Reading user emotional state from text signals — caps, punctuation density, repetition, latency — and adapting before the user disengages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文本信号识别用户情绪并主动调整交互
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在用户失去耐心前感知并调整对话策略
copy.tagline_en: Detect user emotion from text signals and adapt interactions proactively
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to sense and adjust dialogue strategy before users disengage

howto.what: Claude 会从你的文字中识别沮丧信号（如全大写、重复提问、感叹号密集、脏话等），累积判断后自动调整回应语气：放慢节奏、更温和、缩短安慰、直接解决问题，但不直接说“你沮丧”。
howto.when: 当你连续使用多个沮丧信号（如全大写加重复提问），或累积信号达到分数阈值（2分调语气，5分升级处理）时触发。注意：单次信号不触发，需累积。

say.note: 触发全大写和感叹号信号，累积分数促使语气更温和快捷。

say.text: 我试了三次都不行，这功能太烂了！
say.note: 重复抱怨加负面词，累积分数触发语气调整或升级。

howto.what_en: Claude detects frustration signals from your text (e.g., ALL CAPS, repeated questions, heavy punctuation, profanity). It accumulates scores and adapts response style: slower pace, warmer tone, concise empathy, direct fixes — without naming your emotion.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you use multiple frustration signals (e.g., ALL CAPS + repetition) or cumulative signal scores reach thresholds (2 for tone shift, 5 for escalation). Single signals do not trigger; detection requires accumulation.

say_en.text: I've tried three times, this feature is useless!
